entries.name: Jane Anne Kennedy

expected.charges: Destruction of Selective Service records (the October 31, 1969 Indianapolis raid) — United States v. Donner.
expected.sentence: Verdict as recorded: Convicted; two of the eight received probation.

updates.sentence: Four-year sentence reduced to three years for the Indianapolis draft-record action. Began the Alderson federal prison term in 1975. Her November 1975 interview describes seven months served so far and a temporary seven-day furlough; neither is treated as the completed term or final release. The separate earlier Michigan imprisonment concerned the Dow Chemical action.

entries.rationale: November 6, 1975 WFMT interview distinguishes current Alderson term, seven months served so far, from completed 14-month Michigan term. Record 1975 start at year precision only; furlough is not final release.
